subject.title: Manual context clearing for tool results

question: Should OpenClaw add caller-directed tool-result clearing as destructive transcript rewrite, model-context-only masking, or recoverable archival, and which CLI/agent/tool-call adapters should expose that contract?
rationale: The request adds core lifecycle/API semantics that affect session replay, persistence, compaction, authorization, and agent control, so automation should not choose those product and safety semantics.

options.title: Design Canonical Archive/Clear Contract
options.body: Define one lifecycle operation with stable ids, authorization, persistence, recovery, and replay semantics before adding CLI or agent-facing adapters.

options.title: Keep Automatic Pruning Only
options.body: Decline manual clearing for now and improve docs or heuristics around TTL, truncation, compaction, new sessions, and reset.

options.title: Implement Narrow Destructive Clear
options.body: Add only a targeted clear-by-id operation, accepting that recovery and audit semantics are intentionally minimal.

recommendation.title: Design Canonical Archive/Clear Contract
recommendation.body: Define one lifecycle operation with stable ids, authorization, persistence, recovery, and replay semantics before adding CLI or agent-facing adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent cache-TTL pruning and product-review history for this exact issue family.
